text:
sophie.chan: Heads-up — we pushed the KMS auditstream mapping change to consolidate partner logs to the 'kms-central' sink a few mins ago. I just noticed Vault rewrap operations aren't appearing in the new stream :eyes:. Can folks confirm if they see the same?

matt-r: seeing gaps. opened https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1429 with initial logs. looks like the IAM role scope in the new mapping omitted the `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` permission for the vault-service-account.

eva-g: hmm, that permission is usually on the KMS consumer role we attach during onboarding. Sophie — can you paste the mapping change?

sophie.chan: pasted below (diff from deploy):
```
- sink: kms-central
- filter: resource.type="cloudkms_key"
+ sink: kms-central
+ filter: resource.type="cloudkms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName!="google.cloud.audit.None"
```
Also the IAM binding we applied: `roles/logging.logWriter` -> kms-forwarder-sa. I think the key-level permissions for Vault weren't touched, but the mapping filter may be dropping admin audit events.

ryan_k: quick check: query last 24h for methodName=Encrypt/Decrypt on the old sink and new sink: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloudkms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:Rewrap' --order=timestamp --project=infra-logging`

audit-bot: automated alert: vault-rewrap-errors spike at 2026-03-22T18:12:03Z (5m anomaly). Ticket SEC-1429 created, priority P2.

matt-r: suggestion — revert the filter to include admin & rewrap method names, then reindex. Revert will be quick but needs approval for rollout window.

sophie.chan: +1. We should avoid reindexing if possible. If we re-add methodName checks we should also ensure log sink identity has `roles/cloudkms.viewer` at the key ring level so it can see the events.

eva-g: also, RBAC changes incoming — we're changing the vault-service-account scope to a narrow key access role earlier this week as part of least-privilege. That may have removed a viewing permission accidentally. I can open a PR to add `roles/cloudkms.viewer` on the relevant key ring for the sink principal, scoped to the single ring used by Vault.

ryan_k: timeline? We have a scheduled rotation for staging auth keys tonight at 23:00. If audit is missing we should pause the rotation until we confirm visibility. @oncall-rota can you hold the rotation or confirm it's safe?

oncall-rota: holding rotation for staging — will keep team posted. If we do a revert it's fine.

sophie.chan: ok plan: 1) eva to add viewer binding for sink principal scoped to the vault ring; 2) matt to revert audit filter to include rewrap/admin events; 3) I will validate event appearance and re-run a small test rewrap; 4) if green, allow staging rotation to proceed; 5) follow-up to tighten RBAC with a documented exception for audit visibility.

eva-g: taking step 1 now, will post PR link. ETA 25m.

matt-r: prepping revert patch, will need a quick deploy approval (low risk). ETA 10m.

sophie.chan: test snippet to exercise a rewrap (staging):
```bash
# run on staging creds
VAULT_ADDR=https://staging-vault.redwood.example vault operator rewrap -key=staging-wrap-key -insecure
# then check logs
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloudkms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:Rewrap' --project=infra-logging --limit=5
```

ryan_k: if PRs are green ping me and I'll run the test. Also please add a note to the incident runbook about audit coverage change so we don't miss this on future RBAC tweaks.

audit-bot: note appended to SEC-1429: "auditstream filter change masked KMS admin events; required role binding for sink principal."

eva-g: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/441 — adds `roles/cloudkms.viewer` to `projects/infra-keys/locations/global/keyRings/vault-keys` for `serviceAccount:kms-forwarder-sa@infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

matt-r: revert PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/442 — restores filter to include admin/rewrap events.

sophie.chan: deploying revert now.

(3m later)
sophie.chan: revert deployed, eva's binding is applied. Re-running the test rewrap now.

(1m later)
sophie.chan: logs now show the rewrap event in kms-central: `protoPayload.methodName=google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.RewrapCryptoKeyVersion` — looks good :thumbsup:. Staging rotation can proceed.

oncall-rota: confirmed rotation proceed at 23:00. I'll monitor alerts.

ryan_k: filing a follow-up to the RBAC playbook: add a checklist item to verify sink principal key-level viewer perms after any least-privilege change.

sophie.chan: thanks everyone. I'll close SEC-1429 after we add playbook item and a short postmortem note.

matt-r: adding note to runbook now.

(End of thread)
